Gets a feed's details and its latest ite: Gets a feed's details and its latest items, newest first.
Gets the latest items from several feeds: Gets the latest items from several feeds as one list, newest first.
Finds the RSS and Atom feeds a website p: Finds the RSS and Atom feeds a website publishes.
Link to the feed itself, not the site ho: Link to the feed itself, not the site homepage; Atom works too.
Maximum number of items to return, newes: Maximum number of items to return, newest first (1–100). Defaults to 20.
Only return items published after this d: Only return items published after this date and time. Items without a publish date are left out.
Only return items whose title, summary o: Only return items whose title, summary or content contains this text (case-insensitive).
One feed address per row; a feed that fa: One feed address per row; a feed that fails to load is skipped.
A page on the site, such as its homepage: A page on the site, such as its homepage or a blog post.
Runs when a new item is published in an: Runs when a new item is published in an RSS feed.
Runs when a new item is published in any: Runs when a new item is published in any of the feeds you list.
